title: heritiera polyandra
intro: Heritiera polyandra, commonly known as the Malabar umbrage, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Heritiera polyandra include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
